# IMPLYMemristiveISA

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An instruction set architecture designed for IMPLY-based memristive processing, enabling logic-in-memory operations within neuromorphic hardware. Defines a low-level programming model that aligns with TCC's in-network compute paradigm, allowing memristive arrays to serve as both memory and processing elements in distributed topologies.
